pipeline_result.response: Chris Menges is an English cinematographer and film director, while Aram Avakian was a film editor and director. Therefore, they both share the occupation of being involved in the field of filmmaking.
retrieved_context: Chris Menges: Chris Menges BSC, ASC (born 15 September 1940) is an English cinematographer and film director.  He is a member of both the American and British Societies of Cinematographers.

Aram Avakian: Aram A. Avakian (April 23, 1926 – January 17, 1987) was an Armenian-American film editor and director.  His work in the latter role includes "Jazz on a Summer's Day" (1960) and the indie film "End of the Road" (1970).

Second Best (film): Second Best is a 1994 British film produced by Sarah Radclyffe and directed by Chris Menges.  It closely follows the 1991 novel of the same name by David Cook, who also wrote the screenplay.
